code_quality.description: maxTaskID in plan.go and maxTaskIDInQueue in taskloop.go are duplicate logic: both iterate over t-NNN identifiers, parse the numeric suffix, and return the maximum. The only difference is the input type ([]runstore.Task vs []taskEntry).
code_quality.suggested_fix: Extract a shared helper that accepts []string of task IDs and call it from both sites.

code_quality.description: runstore.InvocationRecord and evidence.InvocationRecord are structurally identical structs. The evidence stage manually copies every field between them in a loop. Adding a new field to one requires updating both the struct definition and the copy loop.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Consolidate to a single InvocationRecord type, or eliminate evidence.InvocationRecord and use runstore.InvocationRecord directly.

code_quality.description: contractsDir and fixtureBase are hardcoded absolute paths (/Users/dabrams/gromit/contracts, /tmp/gromit-fixtures). This prevents the e2e suite from running on any machine other than the author's.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Derive contractsDir from the test binary's location or a GROMIT_ROOT env var; make fixtureBase configurable via GROMIT_FIXTURE_BASE.

code_quality.description: BuildBinary hardcodes cmd.Dir = "/Users/dabrams/gromit". Same portability problem as the test constants.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Use runtime.Caller(0) or os.Executable() to determine the repo root dynamically.

code_quality.description: filterForbiddenFixTasks uses heuristic substring matching on spec constraint text to detect test-file restrictions. A spec phrased differently (e.g. 'existing tests shall remain unmodified') silently bypasses enforcement.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Use a structured constraint representation (e.g. a ForbiddenFilePatterns []string field on RunState) rather than free-text heuristics.

code_quality.description: The baseline DetectFilesChanged call before RunTask is silenced with //nolint:errcheck and the returned []string{} is discarded. The two-call stateful contract of the closure is invisible at the call site; a reader cannot tell this is intentionally a side-effecting baseline capture.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Add a named wrapper or comment block that makes the two-call protocol explicit, e.g. `captureFileBaseline(cfg, workDir)` for the first call.

code_quality.description: RunTaskLoop handles budget checks, baseline capture, task execution, error recovery, delta computation, NeedsSplit heuristic promotion, decomposition renumbering, structural test-file coverage checks, repair loops with their own structural checks, and result emission — too many distinct responsibilities for one function.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Extract distinct phases into named helpers: runSingleTask, applyInspection, handleNeedsSplit.

code_quality.description: PlannerDecomposer.Decompose builds the spec packet from the task objective alone. The decomposer planner has no visibility into the original spec requirements, acceptance criteria, or constraints, so sub-tasks generated by decomposition may contradict spec-level rules inherited by the parent task.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Pass rs.SpecConstraints and the spec packet string to PlannerDecomposer and include them in the decomposition PlanRequest.

code_quality.description: The comment block '// See CLAUDE.md nil-field normalization visibility convention: // exported — cross-package boundary type' is placed before NormalizeNilFields as a floating remark rather than as documentation for the method.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Move it to be a proper godoc comment on the method, or remove it and rely on CLAUDE.md alone.

code_quality.description: effectiveStatus still uses `allDone && FinalValidationPassed && FinalReviewPassed && FinalAcceptancePassed` to derive ready_for_review, but FinalizeStage.Run was updated in this same diff to check only the three gate booleans (removing the allDone requirement). These two status-derivation paths are now inconsistent: a run where all three gates pass but some tasks have status 'failed' (the exact scenario validated by the new TestFinalizeStage_AllGatesPassedWithFailedTask_ReadyForReview test) will be finalized as ready_for_review by FinalizeStage but rendered as needs_human in effectiveStatus, causing summary.md and review.md to show the wrong terminal state.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Remove the allDone loop from effectiveStatus, mirroring the updated FinalizeStage logic: `if rs.FinalValidationPassed && rs.FinalReviewPassed && rs.FinalAcceptancePassed { return StatusReadyForReview }`

code_quality.description: The structural test-file coverage check — verifying every *_test.go in expected_touched_area appears in result.FilesChanged — is copy-pasted verbatim in two places inside RunTaskLoop: once after initial inspection and again after each repair retry. The two identical ~15-line blocks share no helper function.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Extract the check into a named helper: `func applyTestFileCoverageCheck(ir *InspectResult, task runstore.Task, filesChanged []string)`, then call it from both sites.

spec_alignment.description: maxTaskID (in plan.go) and maxTaskIDInQueue (in taskloop.go) are duplicate logic: both iterate over t-NNN identifiers, parse the numeric suffix, and return the maximum. The only difference is input type ([]runstore.Task vs []taskEntry).

spec_alignment.description: runstore.InvocationRecord and evidence.InvocationRecord are structurally identical structs. The evidence stage manually copies every field between them in a loop. This is fragile: adding a new field to one requires updating the other and the copy loop.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Consolidate to a single canonical InvocationRecord type (likely in runstore, since it is the lower-level package) and have evidence import it directly.

spec_alignment.description: contractsDir and fixtureBase are hardcoded absolute paths (/Users/dabrams/gromit/contracts, /tmp/gromit-fixtures). This prevents the e2e suite from running on any machine other than the author's.

spec_alignment.description: BuildBinary hardcodes cmd.Dir = "/Users/dabrams/gromit". Same portability problem as the test constants in harness_test.go.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Derive the repo root dynamically (e.g. walk up from the test file's directory or use an environment variable).

spec_alignment.description: filterForbiddenFixTasks uses heuristic substring matching on spec constraint text ("test file" + "do not modify" / "must not be modified" / "not modify") to decide whether to filter tasks. A spec that phrases the constraint differently (e.g. "existing tests shall remain unmodified") silently bypasses enforcement.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Consider a structured constraint representation (a parsed list of forbidden file globs) rather than free-text heuristics, or at least expand the phrase list and add a test for alternative phrasings.

spec_alignment.description: The baseline DetectFilesChanged call before RunTask is silenced with //nolint:errcheck and the returned []string{} is discarded. The two-call stateful contract of the closure is invisible at the call site; a reader cannot tell this is intentionally a side-effecting baseline capture.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Add an inline comment explaining the stateful closure contract: `// First call: captures baseline; return value intentionally discarded.`

spec_alignment.description: RunTaskLoop has grown to handle: budget checks, baseline capture, task execution, error recovery, delta computation, NeedsSplit heuristic promotion, decomposition renumbering, structural test-file coverage checks, repair loops with their own structural checks, and result emission. The function is doing too many distinct things and will be difficult to reason about or extend.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Extract at least two helpers: one for the inspect-and-repair sub-loop and one for the needs_split/decomposition path. This keeps the main loop focused on sequencing.

spec_alignment.description: PlannerDecomposer.Decompose builds the spec packet from the task objective alone: "Decompose this task into smaller sub-tasks:\n\n" + task.Objective. The decomposer planner has no visibility into the original spec requirements, acceptance criteria, or constraints, so sub-tasks may contradict spec-level rules inherited by the parent.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Pass rs.SpecConstraints (and ideally the original spec packet) into PlannerDecomposer so the decomposition prompt includes hard constraints.

spec_alignment.description: The comment block "// See CLAUDE.md nil-field normalization visibility convention: // exported — cross-package boundary type" is placed before the NormalizeNilFields method but reads as a floating remark rather than method documentation.
spec_alignment.suggested_fix: Move the convention comment to immediately precede the method signature line, or fold it into a proper godoc comment on the method.
